metadata.policy: UDM20 Second-Pass Minoan Triad Standard: Enforces strict diachronic separation across the Minoan Script Triad (Cretan Hieroglyphic ↔ Linear A ↔ Phaistos Disc). All anachronistic Late Bronze Age Mycenaean Greek retrofits (to-so, o-pe-ro, do-e-ro, ki-ti-me-na, me-ga-ro, te-me-no, i-qi-ja, po-ti-ni-ja, e-ne), Classical Athenian Greek terms (pa-na-te-ne-ja), and modern English phonetic placeholders (re-ko-de, spi-ra) from v7.0 have been stripped from active transliterations and archived in legacy_greek_and_english_proxies_deprecated. Active readings preserve Tier I Pre-Indo-European Minoan substrate lexemes (*wanak-/su-ki, *qasireu, *dupure, *korete, *kuro, *kiro, *maru/*tunano, *(j)asasarame, *dedero, *tek-), Tier II Eastern Mediterranean Wanderwörter (*kako, *kuruso, *yane/*wino, *erepa), and pure logographic classifications.

project.phase: UDM20 Second-Pass Complete Audit + Minoan Triad & Balkan-Aegean Substrate Concordance

historical_context.period: c. 1700–1600 BCE (Middle Minoan IIIB context, excavated alongside Linear A tablet PH 1)
historical_context.region: Phaistos Palace Archive (Room 101), South-Central Crete (parallel sign 21 attested on Knossos/Minoan seal fragment HM 992 and Arkalochori Axe)
historical_context.script_type: Pre-Indo-European Minoan Logo-Syllabic Administrative & Liturgical Spiral Script

methodology.description: Universal Decipherment Methodology v20 (UDM20) Second-Pass Minoan Triad Protocol. Anchors the 45 stamped sign types in the archaeological reality of the Phaistos Palace Archive (found directly alongside Linear A tablet PH 1) and cross-correlates them against the 61-sign Cretan Hieroglyphic Master Lexicon, the 85-sign Linear A Master Lexicon, and the Pre-IE Aegean-Balkan substrate.

spiral_structure_methodology.reading_direction: Inward/outward spiral segmented into 61 radial word/clause compartments (Faces A and B) delimited by incised vertical divider lines and terminal punctate/oblique strokes (U+101FD).
spiral_structure_methodology.minoan_triad_bridge: Shares identical administrative slot grammar ([Header/Seal Operator] → [Authority/Official] → [Vessel/Commodity] → [Numeral/Summation: ku-ro]) with Linear A and Cretan Hieroglyphs.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *wanak- (Pre-IE Cretan substrate → LB wa-na-ka; cf. LA su-ki & Vinča *wan-)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.meaning: authority, ruler, paramount palatial official
entries.context: Always clause-initial opener on Faces A and B (often followed by Sign 12 Shield); Minoan palatial hierarchy header
entries.notes: Sign 02 (Plumed/Crested Head) occurs 19 times and exclusively occupies the initial position of its radial compartment, confirming its status as a clause-initial authority header/determinative homologous to CH001 and LA001.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *dupure (Pre-IE Minoan scribal/master official → LA du-pu2-re, CM du-pu-re; Balkan *kar-)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.meaning: scribe, administrative agent, record keeper
entries.context: Scribal agent designation in Phaistos palace administrative networks
entries.notes: Replaces legacy v7.0 string 'ka-ra-te' with the verified Pre-IE Minoan scribal/master official root *dupure (attested in Linear A du-pu2-re and Cypro-Minoan CM002 du-pu-re).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *gher- / *karp- (Pre-IE agricultural cereal root; logogram GRA)
entries.meaning: grain, wheat, barley, agricultural cereal commodity
entries.context: Agricultural commodity administration in Phaistos palatial magazines
entries.notes: Decouples the Late Bronze Age Greek proxy 'si-to' (sitos) and anchors the commodity in the Minoan GRA logogram (LA AB120 / CH014) and Pre-IE cereal root *gher-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *ka- / *kwa- (Pre-IE container root; Linear A vessel terms su-pu, qa-pa, ka-ro-pa3)
entries.translation: Storage Vessel / Dolium / Pithos Container Determinative
entries.meaning: vessel, storage jar, ceramic container determinative
entries.context: Storage container administration in Phaistos palace magazines
entries.notes: Purges the misplaced Cretan toponym 'a-mi-ni-so' (Amnisos) from v7.0 and binds Sign 20 (Dolium/Jar) to Linear A vessel classifier A400-VAS (su-pu / qa-pa) and Pre-IE container root *ka-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *bu- / *mu- (Pre-IE bovid horn/cattle root → Linear A AB23 mu / BOS)
entries.meaning: livestock, cattle, bovine pastoral resources
entries.context: Pastoral livestock administration in the Messara Plain / Phaistos economy
entries.notes: Replaces Indo-European 'bo-pi' with the Minoan BOS logogram (CH 012 → LA AB23 mu) and Pre-IE bovid horn root *bu-.

unicode.name: PHAISTOS DISC SIGN COMBINING OBLIQUE STROKE

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: 1 (Aegean base-10 unit stroke; Pre-IE *ek-/*un-)
entries.translation: Numeral One / Base Unit Tally & Clause Sub-Delimiter Stroke
entries.meaning: one, unity, numerical base unit and terminal sub-stroke
entries.frequency: universal (18 incised oblique strokes on disc)
entries.context: Base numerical unit and incised sub-glyph stroke marker in Minoan accounting
entries.notes: Purges Indo-European Greek 'e-ne' (hen- < PIE *sem-) per the Cretan Second-Pass Numeral Policy and normalizes to arithmetic 1 / Pre-IE *ek-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *elaiw- (Pre-IE Mediterranean arboricultural substrate; logogram OLE)
entries.meaning: olive, olive oil, arboricultural liquid commodity
entries.context: Olive harvest and pressed olive oil administration in Phaistos and Messara press rooms
entries.notes: Sign 35 (Branch/Olive Foliage) parallels CHIC *154/*158 and Linear A A302 (OLE). Strips the Mycenaean Greek inflection 'e-ra-wa' in accordance with CH012.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *maru (Pre-IE Minoan MA+RU wool > Gk. mallos) & *tunano (Pre-IE Minoan cloth term → LB tu-na-no)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.translation: Wool / Flax Fiber & Woven Textile Output
entries.meaning: textile, wool, linen, woven goods
entries.context: Textile production administration and loom-weight workshop records at Phaistos
entries.notes: Anchored in the Pre-IE Minoan textile vocabulary *maru (Linear A monogram A 559 MA+RU = LANA) and *tunano (CH027).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kako (Pan-Aegean/Cypriot metallurgical term → LA/LB/CM ka-ko; Balkan *ukar-)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier II: Eastern Mediterranean Areal Wanderwort
entries.translation: Copper / Bronze Metal Ingot & Foundry Resource
entries.meaning: bronze, copper ingot, metallurgical resource
entries.context: Copper/bronze metallurgy and foundry allocations at Phaistos (cf. Arkalochori bronze axe)
entries.notes: Normalizes v7.0 'ka-ke-u' (which carried the Mycenaean Greek agent suffix -eus) to the uninflected Aegean-Cypriot metallurgical root *kako (ka-ko, CH013 / CM014).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Pure Pictographic Logogram (homologous to CH040 / CHIC 040)
entries.meaning: ship, maritime transport vessel, sea dispatch
entries.context: Maritime transport administration linking Phaistos with the harbor of Kommos
entries.notes: Sign 25 (Ship with high prow) is an unmistakable Minoan hull icon matching CHIC 040 (CH040) and harbor sealings connected to Kommos (the port of Phaistos). Strips the Indo-European Greek dative plural 'na-u-si' (*naus).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Logogram (LB proxy me-ri stripped per CH025)
entries.meaning: honey, beeswax, sweet ritual offering
entries.context: Apicultural rations and sanctuary libation offerings at Phaistos
entries.notes: Matches CH025 policy: strips Indo-European Greek 'me-ri' (meli < PIE *mélit) and retains logographic status with Linear A proxy pa-ni.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *a-sa- (Prepalatial/Protopalatial sacral title 042-019; LB proxy i-je-re-u/ja stripped per CH004)
entries.meaning: priest, priestess, sanctuary cult administrator
entries.context: Sanctuary cult management and ritual offering formulas at Phaistos
entries.notes: Sign 03 (Head with cheek/forehead ritual marks) parallels Minoan sacral portraiture. Strips Mycenaean Greek 'i-je-re-ja' (hiereia) per CH004.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Anthropomorphic Workforce Logogram (homologous to Linear A A100-102 & CH050)
entries.meaning: worker, laborer, corvée workforce unit
entries.context: Palatial labor force rosters and ration allocations
entries.notes: Strips Mycenaean Greek 'do-e-ro' (doulos) and aligns with Linear A A100-102 and Cretan Hieroglyphic CH050.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *tel- / *da- (Pre-IE Aegean-Balkan land/territory root; CH031 district determinative)
entries.meaning: land, territory, administrative district
entries.context: Territorial district administration across the Messara Plain
entries.notes: Purges Indo-European Mycenaean Greek 'ki-ti-me-na' (ktimena < PIE *tḱey-) and anchors in CH031 and Pre-IE *tel- / *da-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *wanak-ta (Pre-IE Cretan palatial complex > LB wa-na-ka-te-ro; cf. Vinča VC032 *wan-vel-)
entries.linguistic_tier: Architectural Logogram + Tier I Pre-IE Root
entries.translation: Palace Plan / Central Palatial Complex (Phaistos / Knossos)
entries.meaning: palace, architectural court complex, central administrative hub
entries.frequency: low (2 occurrences, also attested on seal HM 992)
entries.context: Phaistos Palace architectural complex; directly attested on Minoan seal fragment HM 992

minoan_triad_concordance.cretan_hieroglyphs: Seal HM 992 (exact graphic match to Sign 21)

entries.notes: Sign 21 (Palace Plan / Comb) is physically attested on Minoan seal fragment HM 992 (Cretan Report Phase 6), proving same-civilization graphic identity. Strips Mainland Greek 'me-ga-ro' (megaron).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kuruso (East Med Semitic/Aegean trade loan hurāṣu / harus → LB ku-ru-so, CH017)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier II: Eastern Mediterranean Areal Wanderwort
entries.meaning: gold, precious metal, elite treasury bullion
entries.context: Palatial treasury inventories at Phaistos
entries.notes: Retained under Tier II as an Eastern Mediterranean areal Wanderwort (*kuruso < Semitic hurāṣu), matching CH017.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Ceremonial Axe/Mattock Logogram (homologous to CH030 Labrys / AB08 a; Pre-IE *sak-vir-)
entries.meaning: ritual, sacred ceremony, consecration act
entries.context: Sanctuary ceremonial administration and libation dedications
entries.notes: Strips Mycenaean Greek 'te-o-po-ri-ja' (theophoria) and aligns with CH030 (Ceremony/Axe logogram) and Pre-IE *sak-vir-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *buru- (Pre-IE offering/ration share; cf. Tărtăria tarta_015 DO-GO offering)
entries.meaning: tribute, offering, palatial contribution
entries.context: Palatial tribute and sanctuary offering assessments
entries.notes: Strips Mycenaean Greek 'do-so-mo' (dosmos < PIE *deh3-) and aligns with Pre-IE offering/allocation roots *buru- and *do-go-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Sphragistic Authentication Operator (homologous to CH 044 Petschaft & CH 056 Cylinder Seal; Cucuteni CTP-P001)
entries.meaning: seal, official stamp, sphragistic authorization
entries.frequency: very_high (17 occurrences, 13 paired immediately after Sign 02 PD_AUTHORITY)
entries.context: Directly follows Sign 02 (PD_AUTHORITY) 13 times in the opening [𐇑𐇛] prefix formula, functioning identically to Cretan Hieroglyphic 044-049 / 044-005

minoan_triad_concordance.balkan_substrate: AUTO_VC_COMPLETION (◎ *hol- seal) & CTP-P001 (◎ circular pintadera seal)

entries.notes: Sign 12 (Circular bossed roundel/shield with 7 peripheral dots) co-occurs 13 times immediately after Sign 02 (𐇑𐇛), enacting the exact sphragistic authentication header [AUTHORITY + SEAL] proven for CH 044 in Phase 3 of the Cretan Hieroglyphic Second Pass.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *men- / *men-vir- (Pre-IE/Nostratic lunar month/seasonal cycle root; cf. CT-067 mēn & AUTO_VC_SEASON)
entries.meaning: month, lunar period, seasonal accounting cycle
entries.context: Temporal administration and Minoan lunar-solar ritual calendar
entries.notes: Replaces the Mycenaean Greek genitive singular inflection 'me-no' (mēnos) with the uninflected macro-substrate root *men- / *men-vir-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Positional Section Delimiter (paralleling CHIC X header stiktogram, Linear B *49, and Vinča VC041 *vir-ap-)
entries.translation: Spiral Section Delimiter / Structural Boundary Marker
entries.meaning: spiral section marker, structural boundary delimiter
entries.context: Spiral section delimiter paralleling Linear B Sign *49 (Cretan & Linear B Reports)
entries.notes: Purges the modern English/Latin string 'spi-ra' from v7.0 and classifies the sign as a non-phonetic/structural section delimiter homologous to CHIC stiktograms and Linear B *49.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kuro (Indisputable Pre-IE Minoan summation term → Linear A ku-ro / po-to-ku-ro, CH060)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.meaning: total, sum, complete aggregate amount
entries.context: Summation operator in Minoan palatial accounting (attested across Haghia Triada and Phaistos)
entries.notes: Replaces the Mycenaean Greek word 'to-so' (tossos) with the authentic Pre-IE Minoan summation term *kuro (ku-ro), attested throughout Linear A archives in the Messara Plain (Haghia Triada and Phaistos).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *ap-ad- (Pre-IE directional transfer/delivery root; cf. Dispilio ap ... ad & AUTO_VC_TRADE)
entries.meaning: delivery, contribution, remittance transfer
entries.context: Economic remittance and commodity delivery into the Phaistos magazines
entries.notes: Strips the Mycenaean Greek aorist verb 'a-pe-do-ke' (apedōke, 'he gave back') and anchors in the Pre-IE transfer root *ap-ad-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kat- / *baita- (Pre-IE household estate/holding root; cf. VC021 & tarta_012)
entries.meaning: holding, possession, allotted estate
entries.context: Land tenure and palatial estate allotments at Phaistos
entries.notes: Strips Mycenaean Greek 'e-ke-ra' (from PIE *seǵh- > ekhō) and anchors in Pre-IE estate/holding roots.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kiro (Attested Pre-IE Minoan accounting deficit term → Linear A ki-ro; cf. CH028 Hide & Vinča *ap-ka-)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate (+ CH028 Hide Polysemy)
entries.translation: Deficit / Owed Quota (ki-ro) [Polysemic with CH028 Stretched Hide Logogram]
entries.meaning: deficit, owing, balance shortfall (or stretched hide craft logogram CH028)
entries.context: Minoan accounting balance shortfall (Linear A ki-ro) and palatial hide/leather inventories (CH028)
entries.notes: Replaces the Mycenaean Greek accounting term 'o-pe-ro' (ophelos) with the authentic Pre-IE Minoan deficit marker *kiro (ki-ro, universally attested opposite ku-ro in Linear A ledgers), while noting the direct iconographic identity of Sign 27 (Pelt/Hide) with CH028.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *korete (Pre-IE Minoan district coordinator/collector → LA/LB ko-re-te, CH005, CM005)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.meaning: collector, district mayor, bureaucratic coordinator
entries.context: Regional collection and workshop coordination in Phaistos palatial administration
entries.notes: Verified Tier I Pre-IE Minoan administrative title *korete (ko-re-te), shared across CH005, Linear A, Cypro-Minoan CM005, and Linear B.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *buru- (Pre-IE ration disbursement / fractional share; cf. CH301–309 & AUTO_VC_ALLOCATION)
entries.meaning: allocation, ration assignment, resource distribution
entries.context: Ration distribution and fractional commodity allocations at Phaistos
entries.notes: Strips Indo-European Greek 'ne-wo' (newos < PIE *néwos) and binds to Pre-IE ration allocation root *buru-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *kar-ta- / *pak- (Pre-IE hand-incised/stamped canonical document; cf. CHIC 008/009 & VC002/VC040)
entries.meaning: record, stamped document, canonical inscription
entries.context: Administrative documentation and hand-authenticated record keeping at Phaistos
entries.notes: Purges the modern English phonetic string 're-ko-de' ('record') from v7.0 and anchors Sign 08 (Gauntlet/Fist) in the Minoan hand-sign series (CHIC 008/009) and Pre-IE *kar-ta- / *pak-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *qasireu (Pre-IE Minoan provincial governor/overseer → LA/LB qa-si-re-u, CH002, CM004)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Substrate
entries.meaning: governor, supervisor, regional chieftain, overseer
entries.context: Provincial and workshop supervisory oversight in the Phaistos hierarchy (completing the Minoan Authority Triad with PD_AUTHORITY, PD_SCRIBE, and PD_COLLECTOR)
entries.notes: Replaces Mycenaean Greek 'e-pi-ko-wo' (epikowos) with the verified Pre-IE Minoan governor/overseer rank *qasireu (qa-si-re-u, CH002 / CM004), completing the 4-part Minoan administrative hierarchy table from the Linear B and Cretan reports.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *hol- (Pre-IE Aegean-Balkan stative completion/sealing operator; cf. dispilio_008 & AUTO_VC_COMPLETION)
entries.meaning: completion, fulfillment, sealed transaction state
entries.context: Administrative transaction closure and container sealing (Sign 17 Lid)
entries.notes: Strips Greek 'te-re-ja' (teleia) and anchors Sign 17 (Circular Lid/Cover) in the Pre-IE completion/sealing operator *hol-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *a-sa (Archanes sacral-institutional shrine formula 042-019) & *sak-mal- (Pre-IE sanctuary ligature VC024)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Sacral Formula
entries.meaning: sanctuary, sacred precinct, peak shrine
entries.context: Minoan peak sanctuaries (such as Mount Kamares above Phaistos) and palatial shrines
entries.notes: Strips Mycenaean Greek 'te-me-no' (temenos < PIE *temh1-) and binds to the indigenous Minoan Archanes shrine formula 042-019 (a-sa) and Pre-IE *sak-mal-.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: CH015b Horned Ram Sacrificial/Festival Logogram (Malia MA/P Hi 02 Sign 3b) + Pre-IE *sak-vir- (VC062)
entries.meaning: festival, sacrificial ram offering, seasonal religious gathering
entries.context: Seasonal sacrificial feasts and diacritical feasting at Minoan palaces (cf. Malia MA/P Hi 02 oversized Ram's head CH015b)

minoan_triad_concordance.cretan_hieroglyphs: CH015b (Curved-Horn Ram Head on Malia bar MA/P Hi 02, conf. 0.80)

entries.notes: Purges the severe anachronism 'pa-na-te-ne-ja' (the Classical Athenian Panathenaia festival!) from v7.0 and anchors Sign 30 (Horned Ram's Head) directly to Cretan Hieroglyphic CH015b (the heraldically oversized Ram's head on Malia clay bar MA/P Hi 02).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *tek- / *tek-kar- (Pre-IE Aegean-Balkan craft/implement root → dispilio_010, VC013, AUTO_VC_CRAFT > Gk. tektōn)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Pre-IE Aegean-Balkan Technological Substrate
entries.meaning: craftsman, artisan, tool specialist
entries.context: Palatial craft specialization and lapidary/metallurgical/carpentry workshops at Phaistos
entries.notes: Sign 16 (Saw/Blade Tool) encodes the Pre-IE technological root *tek- / *tek-kar- (attested on 12 stone adzes at Dispilio and Vinča VC013, later borrowed into Greek tektōn).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *yane / *wino (Areal Mediterranean/Semitic viticultural term → Linear A ya-ne on Knossos pithos, CH026, Ugaritic yn, LB wo-no)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier II: Eastern Mediterranean Areal Wanderwort
entries.meaning: wine, fermented grape produce, libation liquid
entries.context: Viticultural liquid ledgers and sanctuary libations at Phaistos
entries.notes: Prioritizes the attested Minoan Linear A form ya-ne (*yane / *wino, CH026) over the later Mycenaean spelling wo-no.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Pure Logogram (homologous to CH034 Scented Unguent / Lily-Iris CHIC 023, conf. 0.94)
entries.meaning: perfumed oil, aromatic unguent, luxury fragrance
entries.context: Palatial perfume workshop records and sanctuary unguent supplies (paired with CH171 small flasks)
entries.notes: Strips Classical Greek 'a-ro-ma' (arōma) and aligns with CH034 (Perfumed Oil logogram, syllabic value re).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Pure Pictographic Logogram (homologous to CH039 Wheeled Vehicle & CH049 Wheel)
entries.meaning: chariot, wheeled elite vehicle, palatial transport
entries.context: Elite palatial transport and armory allocations
entries.notes: Purges the Indo-European Mycenaean Greek term 'i-qi-ja' (ikkʷia < PIE *h1éḱwos 'horse') and normalizes to a pure logogram matching CH039.

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: *(j)asasarame (Pre-IE Minoan divine recipient from Archanes 042-019 | 019-095-052 & Linear A libation tables; Old European *ma-na)
entries.linguistic_tier: Tier I: Genuine Pre-IE Minoan Divine Title
entries.meaning: goddess, sovereign divine lady, recipient of sanctuary offerings
entries.context: Sanctuary offering sequences and royal/cultic dedications at Phaistos
entries.notes: Sign 06 (Standing Female Figure with pendulous breasts and flared skirt) matches Minoan goddess iconography and CH029. Replaces the Indo-European noun 'po-ti-ni-ja' (PIE *pótnih2) with the indigenous Minoan dedicatory recipient *(j)asasarame.
legacy_greek_and_english_proxies_depreca: po-ti-ni-ja (PIE *pótnih2 retrofit restricted to semantic gloss)

entries.context: Palatial luxury carving workshops and maritime import ledgers via Kommos
entries.notes: Retained under Tier II as an Eastern Mediterranean / Egyptian trade loanword (*erepa, CH036).

entries.pre_ie_substrate_root: Pure Logogram (homologous to CH035 Murex Purple Dye; LB proxy po-pu-re-ja stripped to semantic gloss)
entries.meaning: murex purple dye, royal textile pigment

entries.notes: Matches CH035 in the Cretan Hieroglyphic Second Pass: strips the Mycenaean Greek adjectival inflection 'po-pu-re-ja' to a semantic gloss.

entries.notes: Strips the Classical Greek word 'e-le-ku-to' (ēlektron) and normalizes to a pure logogram matching CH038.

entries.meaning: rock crystal, clear lapidary stone, ritual vessel material
entries.context: Palatial lapidary workshops and ritual vessel inventories
entries.notes: Strips the Classical Greek word 'ka-ra-ta-lo' (krystallos) and normalizes to a pure logogram matching CH037.

entries.meaning: incense, aromatic resin offering, sacred smoke

entries.notes: Strips the Classical Greek word 'ti-mi-a-ma' (thymiama) and normalizes to a pure logogram matching CH033.

entries.context: Minoan peak sanctuary and sacred grove dendrolatry offerings

entries.context: Sanctuary sealings, departmental sector determinative (cf. Myrtos-Pyrgos prism #309.a SM 075 Cat), and Minoan bull/feline cult
